subject: frozen split now honoured by research/evaluate-design
body: research and evaluate-design used benchmarks.split (per-id hash), which disagrees with your frozen evalawarebench_split.json: 35 of the 72 held-out ids fall on the hash dev side, and task pairs can straddle. Added --split-file to both (5daf3e0); E4 prereg and e4_commands pass it. If calibrate or other C1 paths call split() on EvalAwareBench, they may want apply_split too. I haven't touched benchmarks.py.
